name: DESY — Hamburg-Bahrenfeld campus and the HERA ring
notes: Site coordinate correction (for the integrator, not applied here): site:desy-hamburg-campus, site:desy-hera-north-hall-h1 and site:desy-hera-south-hall-zeus all currently carry the same ROR-geocoded point (53.55073N, 9.99302E, precision_m 800). That point is about 10.3 km from DESY's actual Hamburg-Bahrenfeld campus. Two independent sources fetched this session agree with each other instead: (1) OSM way 276641657, the campus landuse polygon itself, tagged with DESY's own postal address (Notkestraße 85, 22607 Hamburg) and centroid 53.5771N, 9.8808E; (2) src:desy-wikipedia's own excerpt, already cited by the existing site record, states the coordinate '53 34'33''N 9 52'46''E' = 53.5758N, 9.8794E -- 150 m from (1) and nothing like the ROR point actually used. See the worklog for the full correction list.

geometry:hera-halle-nord (entity_id site:desy-hera-north-hall-h1) stands in for both detector:h1 (1992-2007) and detector:alps-ii (active, in the same former HERA tunnel straight section); it is not time-sliced because sites carry no independent state_segments in this schema version, matching map:cern's documented over-display of boundary/hall features across every year.

summary.plain: DESY's main laboratory campus in Hamburg-Bahrenfeld, Germany, and the 6.3-km HERA ring tunnel that ran underneath it and the surrounding city district from 1992 to 2007, with the North Hall (H1, now ALPS II) drawn to scale from OpenStreetMap and DESY's own published figures.
summary.technical: One local map for facility:desy spanning the Hamburg-Bahrenfeld campus and the full HERA ring footprint. Geometry sourced from OpenStreetMap (way 24973326 for the HERA ring; way 276641657 for the campus boundary; way 131496014 for the North Hall/H1 building; way 297515305 for the PETRA III storage-ring tunnel, drawn as context) cross-checked against DESY's own published HERA ring length and depth figures.

unlocated.backlog: Fetch a ZEUS TDR or DESY site-plan/GIS layer that names the South Hall building explicitly (by building number, matching the pattern used for 'HERA Halle Nord'); or ask DESY's own facility-map service for the numbered-building index used internally.
unlocated.reason: ZEUS's HERA South Hall has no OpenStreetMap trace under that name: a case-insensitive Overpass name search for 'ZEUS' across a bbox spanning the whole DESY/HERA area (53.55-53.61N, 9.85-9.95E) returned zero elements, as did searches for 'Süd'/'Sued'/'Doppel-Ring' (the DORIS storage ring, whose former South-area straddling hall might otherwise corroborate the location). The nearest generically-named DESY building to the HERA ring's own southern extreme, OSM way 24892547 ('HalleSO', 'service' building, ~89 m from the ring line), is a plausible but unconfirmed candidate -- no fetched source names it as ZEUS's hall, so it is not drawn.
